samplingSequentialDesc: Tasks are ordered by Task ID
samplingRandomDesc: Tasks are chosen with uniform random
uncertaintySamplingDesc: Tasks are chosen according to model uncertainty score (active learning mode).
labelingInstructionsHelp1: Write instructions to help users complete labeling tasks.
labelingInstructionsHelp2: The instruction field supports HTML markup and it allows use of images, iframes (pdf).
usePredictionsToPrelabelDesc: Enable and select which set of predictions to use for prelabeling.
selectPredictionsOrModel: Select which predictions or which model you want to use:
emptyMlDescription: Connect a machine learning model to generate live predictions for your project. Compare predictions, accelerate labeling with automatic prelabeling, and direct your team to the most impactful tasks through active learning.
learnMoreMlAria: Learn more about machine learning models (opens in new window)
mlConnectedDetected: A connected model has been detected! If you wish to fetch predictions from this model, please follow these steps:
mlFetchStep3: 3. Click on <italic>Batch predictions</italic> from the <italic>Actions</italic> menu.
mlPrelabelingHint: If you want to use the model predictions for prelabeling, please configure this in the <link>Annotation settings</link>.
startTrainingOnAnnotationLabel: Start model training on annotation submission
startTrainingOnAnnotationDesc: This option will send a request to /train with information about annotations. You can use this to enable an Active Learning loop. You can also manually start training through model menu in its card.
extraParamsLabel: Any extra params to pass during model connection
interactivePreannotationsDesc: If enabled some labeling tools will send requests to the ML Backend interactively during the annotation process.
failedAddMlBackend: Failed to add new ML backend.
startTrainingIntro: You're about to manually trigger your model's training process. This action will start the learning phase based on how train method is implemented in the ML Backend. Proceed to begin this process.
startTrainingNote: *Note: Currently, there is no built-in feedback loop within this interface for tracking the training progress. You'll need to monitor the model's training steps directly through the model's own tools and environment.
testRequestDescription: This sends a test request to the prediction endpoint of the ML Backend using a random task.
predictionsListDescription: List of predictions available in the project. Each card is associated with a separate model version.
noPredictionsDescription: Upload predictions to automatically prelabel your data and speed up annotation. Import predictions from multiple model versions to compare their performance, or connect live models from the Model page to generate predictions on demand.
learnMorePredictionsAria: Learn more about predictions (opens in new window)
modelVersionUndefinedTooltip: Model version is undefined. Likely means that model_version field was missing when predictions were imported.
importPredictionsDescription: Copy this project-specific example to import predictions. The result structure is pre-filled from this project's {{schemaTerm}} — replace YOUR_API_KEY with a personal access token, and (for the SDK) TASK_ID with the ID of a task in this project. To learn more, see the documentation.
cloudStorageDescription: Use cloud or database storage as the source for your labeling tasks or the target of your completed annotations.
learnMoreCloudStorageAria: Learn more about cloud storage (opens in new window)
syncingTakeTimeHint: Syncing may take some time, please refresh the page to see the current status.
learnMoreTroubleshootingAria: Learn more about cloud storage troubleshooting
troubleshootingTipsText: for troubleshooting tips on cloud storage connections.
statusHelpInitialized: Initialized: storage was added, but never synced; sufficient for starting URI link resolving
statusHelpQueued: Queued: sync job is in the queue, but not yet started
statusHelpInProgress: In progress: sync job is running
statusHelpFailed: Failed: sync job stopped, some errors occurred
statusHelpCompletedWithErrors: Completed with errors: sync job completed but some tasks had validation errors
newTasksAddedHelp: {{count}} new tasks added during the last sync.
tasksExistedHelp: {{count}} tasks that have been found and already synced will not be added to the project again.
tasksTotalHelp: {{count}} tasks have been added in total for this storage.
annotationsSavedHelp: {{count}} annotations successfully saved during the last sync.
totalAnnotationsHelp: {{count}} total annotations seen in the project at the sync moment.

typeWordToProceed: To proceed, type "{{word}}" in the field below:

deleteProjectConfirmMsg: You are about to delete the project {{title}}. This action cannot be undone.
resetCacheHelp: Reset Cache may help in cases like if you are unable to modify the labeling configuration due to validation errors concerning existing labels, but you are confident that the labels don't exist. You can use this action to reset the cache and try again.
dropAllTabsHelp: If the Data Manager is not loading, dropping all Data Manager tabs can help.
deleteProjectHelp: Deleting a project removes all tasks, annotations, and project data from the database.
dangerZoneWarning: Perform these actions at your own risk. Actions you take on this page can't be reverted. Make sure your data is backed up.

localFilesTip: Tip: Create a "mydata" or "label-studio-data" directory next to the command you use to run Label Studio and local file serving will be enabled automatically. If you run the Docker image, the app starts in "/label-studio", so you can bind-mount your host folder to "/label-studio/mydata" or "/label-studio/label-studio-data" inside the container to enable local file serving without extra configuration.
